title: Triple selection excludes the outer tapes
statement: For every finite Boolean Turing machine $M$, source tape $i$, and $r\in\{0,1\}$, selection for tape $i$ is undefined at the physical index assigned to component $r$ of the argument-and-capture pair.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$i$ is a source work tape of $M$
replaced:
For every source tape $i$, the triple selection of bank $i$ is undefined at the argument
slot and at the capture slot.
